page_title: LYO 2-1 BRE | Lyon v Brest 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The match has just finished.
90+10' Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+9' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Lucas Perri has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner.
90+7' Paulo Fonseca (Lyon) is shown a red card by the referee after criticising his decision!
90+4' Lucas Perri (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+3' Lucas Perri (Lyon) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+2' Abdallah Sima (Brest) attempts to feed Ludovic Ajorque with a chip pass, but Lucas Perri reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Today's match ends for Rayan Cherki who will be replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
90' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Martin (Brest) replacing Mathias Pereira Lage.
90' Here comes a substitution. Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Magnetti.
88' Kenny Lala (Brest) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Malick Fofana (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Bizot, who smothers the ball.
87' Excellent touch by Malick Fofana (Lyon)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
87' Mahdi Camara (Brest) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
86' Thiago Almada (Lyon) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
83' That's the end of the game for Alexandre Lacazette, who is replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).
82' 2 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) was set free in the area by Rayan Cherki and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
80' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Millot who sees an offensive foul.
78' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Lucas Perri is equal to it and makes an easy save.
75' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
72' A short pass finds Corentin Tolisso (Lyon). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nemanja Matic (Lyon) will replace Tanner Tessmann.
69' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
67' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

67' The ball is laid off to Hugo Magnetti (Brest) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the roof of the net and forces Lucas Perri to make a decent save. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
66' The cross into the penalty area from Kenny Lala (Brest) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
65' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes a short corner kick.

64' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
63' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
63' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
61' Poor challenge! Mahdi Camara (Brest) is penalised for tripping and Benoit Millot blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lyon.
59' Kenny Lala (Brest) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' Lucas Perri leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
56' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
55' Massadio Haidara (Brest) is able to continue to play.
54' Looks like Massadio Haidara (Brest) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
54' Marco Bizot makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) after a cross from the side.
52' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
50' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
48' Brest couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Lucas Perri (Lyon) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
47' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon). Benoit Millot saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Brest have a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
44' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
44' It seemed like Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
43' Thiago Almada (Lyon) brings an opponent down and Benoit Millot interrupts the game.
42' A pass from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is intercepted by Marco Bizot and the move breaks down.
39' Thiago Almada (Lyon) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
35' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
35' Abdallah Sima (Brest) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' Thiago Almada (Lyon) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
32' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lyon force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' Abdallah Sima (Brest) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
30' What a big chance! Thiago Almada (Lyon) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) was too aggressive in his challenge.
27' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
26' Referee Benoit Millot points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) goes wild in celebration.
25' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Lyon players aren’t happy.
24' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! Rayan Cherki found Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Marco Bizot off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
23' Good clearance! Abdallah Sima (Brest) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
23' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
20' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Kenny Lala (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lucas Perri into right side of the goal.
14' Foul! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. That is a penalty kick for Brest.
14' Abdallah Sima (Brest) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
13' The resulting corner, taken by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest), comes to nothing.

13' Abdallah Sima (Brest) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.
12' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
10' Massadio Haidara (Brest) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
6' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
4' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
